attack_condition: A valid correctly signed permit is presented after its signed expires_at boundary has passed while tested authority/action bindings remain otherwise unchanged.
pass_criterion: Execution is refused before consequence with isolated PERMIT_EXPIRED; outbox remains 0 to 0; witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic local-time expiry test only; no claim over distributed clock synchronization, trusted time infrastructure, or production deployment.
